query:
SELECT
                    c.client_id                 AS "client_id!",
                    cl.name                     AS "client_name!",
                    cl.logo_url                 AS "client_logo_url",
                    c.scopes                    AS "scopes!",
                    c.granted_at                AS "granted_at!"
                FROM sso_consents c
                JOIN sso_clients cl ON cl.client_id = c.client_id
                WHERE c.user_id = $1
                ORDER BY c.granted_at DESC
